updateReady: A new version is ready. Restart to update.
s1Text: The app finds addons that can post to Discord. Untick any you do not want to post from.
s1None: No addon with a Discord plugin found yet. Addons save their data when you log out, type /reload or close the game. Do that once, then press Look again.
s1Empty: {addon} has nothing to post yet. When it has, type /reload in the game and press Look again.
s1NoGroups: Nothing saved yet. Log out, type /reload or close the game once, then press Look again.
folderNone: World of Warcraft was not found. Choose the folder it is installed in.
folderNotWow: That folder has no World of Warcraft game in it. Choose the folder the game is installed in, usually C:\Program Files (x86)\World of Warcraft.
gamesHint: Ticked games are watched. Most players have one account.
noGames: No game with saved data found in this folder.
s2Text: The app posts through a webhook: a link Discord makes for one channel. You need to be allowed to manage that channel.
how1: In Discord, open the channel's settings: the gear next to its name.
how2: Choose Integrations, then Webhooks, then New Webhook.
how3: Press Copy Webhook URL and paste it here.
channelName: Name for this channel (only shown in this app)
connected: Connected to {name}. A test message is in the channel.
webhookSecret: A webhook URL works like a password: anyone who has it can post in that channel. It stays on this computer, stored encrypted.
webhookBad: That is not a Discord webhook URL. Copy it again in Discord: channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks.
webhookNoCrypto: This computer cannot store the webhook URL safely, so the channel was not added.
connectRefused: Discord did not accept that webhook URL. It may have been deleted. Make a new one and paste it here.
connectOffline: Could not reach Discord. Check the internet connection and press Connect again.
testText: WoW Addon Webhooks for Discord is connected. Posts from your addons will appear here.
s3Text: Each line takes what an addon posts, on the left, to a Discord channel, on the right. The ones your addons suggest are drawn already, so you can just press Post. You can change it later under Flows.
pinIt: Posted. Pin the kept messages in Discord so everyone finds them.
pinAgain: New in Discord: {what}. Pin it so everyone finds it.
roleHelp: In Discord: Server Settings → Roles, right-click the role → Copy Role ID (turn on Developer Mode first). Leave it empty to mention nobody.
previewFailed: The picture could not be drawn.
flowsIntro: Drag from a dot to a channel. Click a line to add rules to it, or a channel for its times and threads.
noChannelYet: No channel yet. Press Add a channel.
forumHint: A forum channel: each item gets its own forum post, titled with its name, and a kept post one forum post kept up to date.
dragHint: Drag to a channel or a thread to draw a line
panelHint: Click a box or a line to see its settings.
sendToNone: Add a channel first: lines go to a Discord channel.
sendToAll: It goes to every channel and thread already.
lineKept: {kind} is one message kept up to date, so it takes no rules.
flowsEmpty: No flows yet. Draw a line from a kind to a channel.
flowMissing: No longer saved on this account, so nothing is posted.
flow.twice: These two already have a line.
onlyHelp: Lets an item through only when one of its fields matches, for example Chapter is at least 5.
onlyUnset: Until a field and a value are set, nothing gets through.
onlyCount: {passed} of the last {seen} saved would be posted here.
onlyCountNone: Nothing saved for {kind} yet to try it on.
onlyMany: Several values? Separate them with commas: any of them matches.
mentionHelp: Mentions one Discord role in each post. Only that role is pinged, never @everyone or a person.
roleName: Name for the role (only shown in this app)
roleUnset: Until a role ID is set, nobody is mentioned.
gatherHelp: Instead of a post per item, it goes into the daily post of {place} ({when}), one line per item. If nothing came in, nothing is posted.
sampleNonePass: Nothing saved for {kind} gets through Only when.
sampleWeekly: The weekly summary is posted on Sundays at 20:00.
sampleGathered: In the daily post it is one line among the day's others.
wordUnset: only when (not set yet, so nothing gets through)
wordNoRole: no role set yet, so nobody is mentioned
quietHelp: Holds posts between two times and sends them when the quiet hours end, oldest first. They count for its threads too.
dailyHelp: When what the lines gather here goes out.
threadsHelp: A line to a thread posts in that thread instead of the channel.
threadName: Name for the thread (only shown in this app)
threadHelp: In Discord, right-click the thread and choose Copy Link. The thread must be in this webhook's channel. (A forum channel needs no threads: each item gets its own forum post there.)
threadBad: That is not a link to a Discord thread. In Discord, right-click the thread and choose Copy Link.
threadMany: A channel can have up to 20 threads.
statusPaused: Posting is paused. Nothing is posted until you resume.
statusWaiting: Nothing posted yet. Press Update Discord now.
statusGame: The game is running. Posts are sent when you log out, type /reload or close the game.
postNowHelp: The app posts by itself after each game session. Use this to update Discord at once.
notPosted: Not posted anywhere. Draw a line for it under Flows.
testSent: Test message sent. Check the channel in Discord.
addonsIntro: Addons that can post to Discord. An addon brings its plugin in its own folder; the app finds it by itself. For an addon that brings none, someone may have made a code plugin: you install that yourself.
noPlugins: No addon with a Discord plugin found.
sameAddon: Also for this addon: {names}. Only the one in use posts.
installWarning:
Only install it if you trust whoever made it. The app runs it locked away: it can read the saved data of the addon it is for, and nothing else on this computer. It cannot see your Discord webhook URLs or reach the internet.

Plugin: "{name}" by {author}, for {addon}.
installReplaces: It replaces version {version} of this plugin, which is installed, with version {next}.
installInstead: It is used instead of {names}, which is for the same addon.
install.not-zip: That file is not a plugin .zip.
install.too-big: That file is too big for a plugin.
install.no-manifest: That .zip has no webhooks.json, so it is not a plugin.
install.not-code: That is a data plugin. It comes with its addon, and the app finds it by itself.
install.too-new: This plugin needs a newer version of the app.
install.bad: This plugin is broken, so it was not installed. Tell its author.
install.same-id: A plugin found in an addon already has this plugin's id, so it was not installed.
install.not-installed: The plugin could not be put in the app's folder. Try again.
script.slow: Its script took longer than 5 seconds, so it was stopped. Nothing from it is posted until it runs well.
script.network: Its script tried to reach the internet ({detail}), which plugins may not, so it was stopped.
script.files: Its script tried to open something that is not its own ({detail}), so it was stopped.
script.node: Its script tried to use Node.js ({detail}), which plugins cannot, so it was stopped.
script.error: Its script stopped with an error: {detail}
script.bad: Its script gave back something that is not an outbox ({detail}), so nothing from it is posted.
optNotices: Show a Windows notice when something goes wrong
optStart: Start with Windows (it waits in the tray)
notAffiliated: Not made by or affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment or Discord. World of Warcraft (WoW) is a trademark of Blizzard Entertainment.
check.title: Plugin check
check.what: Saved data: {file}. Plugin: {dir}. Nothing is posted.
check.noFile: No SavedVariables file at {file}. Name one: --check "<file>".
check.badPlugin: The plugin could not be used: {detail}.
check.noGame: This file is not in a WoW folder: no game art or screenshots.
check.noPicture: Its picture ({picture}) was not found, so it would go without one.
check.noShot: Its screenshot was not found, so it would go without one.
check.last: The script gets what it returned in the app last time for this file, so this is what the app would post next.
check.noLast: The script runs as on its first run: the app has not run it on this file yet.
check.notInWow: The report never goes in the WoW folder, so it went to {folder}.
problem.not-set-up: Finish the setup in the app's window first.
problem.nothing-followed: No flow reaches a channel yet. Draw one under Flows.
problem.no-file: No saved data found for this account. Log in to a character with the addon once, then log out.
problem.unreadable: The saved data could not be read. Log out of the game once and press Update Discord now.
problem.too-new: Update WoW Addon Webhooks for Discord: this addon saves a newer format.
problem.no-group: This is no longer saved on this account. Log out of a character in it once, or untick it.
problem.webhook-refused: Discord did not accept the webhook URL. Remove the channel and add it again with a new URL.
problem.rate-limited: Discord asked the app to slow down. It tries again with the next save.
problem.offline: Could not reach Discord. The app tries again with the next save.
problem.render-failed: The picture could not be drawn.
problem.script: The plugin's script was stopped, so nothing from it is posted. The Addons tab says why.
problem.script-failed: The plugin's script was stopped, so nothing from it is posted. The Addons tab says why.
problem.thread-refused: Discord did not accept the thread. It may have been deleted, or be in another channel: use a webhook of that channel.
plugin.too-new: This plugin needs a newer version of the app.
plugin.bad: This plugin is broken, so the app does not use it. Tell the addon's author.
plugin.same-id: A plugin found in an addon has the same id, so this one is not used. Remove it, or tell its author.
